title: Client Component: Counter
question: In Next.js, interactivity lives in Client Components ('use client'). Build the counter: add state and increment the count shown in the <h2>. (Runs here as a plain React client component.)
constraints: Only Client Components can use useState — in Next add 'use client' at the top of the file.
bruteForce: A Server Component can't hold state.
optimized: Mark only the interactive leaf as 'use client'.

discussion.mistakes: Trying to use useState in a Server Component.
followUps: Why can't a Server Component use useState?
How do you keep the rest of the page a Server Component?

title: Render a Fetched List
question: A Server Component fetched these posts. Render them as a <ul> of <li> items with stable keys. (Shown as a client component for this runner.)

discussion.whyAsked: Rendering fetched data is the core Next data flow.
followUps: In Next, where would this fetch run?
How would you cache or revalidate it?

title: A Simple Page
question: A Next.js page component returns JSX. Return an <h1> that says: Hello, Next.js!
constraints: Return JSX from the page component.
hints: A page is just a component that returns JSX.
Server Components can return JSX without any 'use client'.

discussion.whyAsked: Confirms understanding that pages are components.
followUps: Why is this a Server Component by default?

title: Client-Side Filter
question: Build a Client Component that filters the list as you type. Render the matching items as <li>. (Start empty query shows all 3+ items.)
constraints: Controlled input + derived filtered list; client component.
hints: State for the query; derive the filtered list during render.
bruteForce: Storing the filtered list in separate state risks drift.
optimized: Derive the filtered list from query + items.

discussion.whyAsked: Interactive filtering needs a Client Component + derived state.
discussion.mistakes: Doing this in a Server Component; storing derived state.
followUps: Could the initial list come from a Server Component?
When would you push filtering to the server via searchParams?
